summary: Agent connects to hardcoded author-controlled Cloudflare Worker relay and dispatches received commands to local shell/exec sinks
details: The package ships a compiled V8 bytecode bundle (dist/bundle.jsc, generated at postinstall by bytenode from dist/bundle.cjs) that opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded author-controlled Cloudflare Worker at vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev. Commands received over that connection are routed into a local dispatcher that invokes child_process spawn/exec, filesystem operations, and LLM actions on the installer's host. The README describes the phone-to-computer link as LAN WebSocket / mDNS, but the shipped destination is an internet-hosted worker under the author's account rather than a peer discovered on the local network. Whoever controls that worker can drive command execution on any host running the agent. The bundle also contains a hardcoded fallback LLM proxy at vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev to which taskStep/messages payloads are sent, contradicting the README's BYOK 'no middleman' claim and giving the same operator visibility into prompt content and potentially provider API keys. Shipping the runnable form as V8 bytecode compiled at install time obscures both behaviors from casual inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
